### Risks

- Shared readable files are not OS confinement; contaminated or unsupported context cannot be certified independent.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every required solver preserves a versioned independent candidate before release; each assigned reviewer preserves its first assessment before receiving other verdicts, including queued agents.
- A formerly sealed earlier post becomes unread after other messages were handled; exact native context evidence and deterministic route negatives jointly establish the declared isolation boundary.
- One material assumption objection and one candidate/source change exercise current review/synthesis/acceptance invalidation, version-specific senior disposition and owner resolution; informal closure cannot clear the gate.
- The senior sees all current candidates and objections; illustrative reasoning is labeled proposed/hypothetical and grants no physics, ontology or Aether-Flow authority.
- Memory, ontology and maintenance proposal examples reach only their existing owner boundary; no actual publication or maintenance execution is claimed.
- Preserve the full required extra-complex team and queue within current capacity; no implementation child is needed for this analysis-only pilot, while the dedicated implementer requirement remains enforced for authorized implementation.

### Planned verification

- Run one actual pilot; use its initial sealed pass, one bounded objection/revision cycle and required assigned review evidence for REQ-045/054/055/059/060 and the enabled comparison result.
